notes: Brackets are the 2026 PRELIMINARY rate schedules published in the 2026 Form IN-114 estimated tax instructions; final 2026 schedules are issued with the 2026 return booklet and may differ slightly.

Standard deduction ($7,650 single / $15,300 MFJ / $11,450 HoH) and personal exemption ($5,300 per person) are the 2025 amounts; Vermont has not yet published 2026 indexed values. Extra $1,250 standard deduction per box for age 65+/blind is not modeled.
Minimum tax (modeled): if federal AGI exceeds $150,000 (all filing statuses), Vermont income tax is the greater of the rate-schedule tax or 3% of federal AGI minus interest from U.S. obligations.
Self-employed individuals owe the Vermont Child Care Contribution of 0.11% of Vermont self-employment income, paid with the income tax return (not modeled).

Not modeled: Vermont additions/subtractions (e.g. non-Vermont municipal bond interest, Social Security and retirement income exclusions), capital gains exclusion, Vermont earned income/child tax credits, dependent exemptions, and credit for taxes paid to other states.

seDeduction.note: Vermont starts from federal AGI, which already reflects the deduction for one-half of self-employment tax.

seHealthInsurance.note: The self-employed health insurance deduction is an above-the-line federal adjustment included in federal AGI, Vermont's starting point.

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) contributions reduce federal AGI and therefore Vermont income.

qbi.note: Vermont starts from federal AGI and applies its own standard deduction and exemptions, so the federal QBI deduction (taken after AGI) is not allowed.

localIncomeTax.note: No local income taxes in Vermont (some towns levy local option sales, rooms/meals taxes, not modeled).

estimatedTax.threshold: Estimated payments are expected if Vermont tax due after withholding and credits will be $500 or more; no underpayment penalty when the amount due is under $500.
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: No underpayment penalty if timely payments total at least the lesser of 100% of the prior-year Vermont tax or 90% of the current-year Vermont tax.
estimatedTax.form: Form IN-114 (Vermont Individual Income Estimated Tax Payment Voucher)

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $155 (Articles of Organization, domestic LLC, Vermont Secretary of State).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $45 per year (domestic LLC annual report, Vermont Secretary of State).
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None for a sole proprietor or single-member LLC taxed as a disregarded entity (income is taxed on the owner's personal return).
